nameOrigin: to engage in thought or contemplation

pokedexEntries.ru: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

pokedexEntries.sa: MEDITITE heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this POKéMON’s training.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

pokedexEntries.em: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

pokedexEntries.di: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
